US pushes companies to skip French space summit

The White House has urged American companies to withdraw from a French-led space summit organized by President Emmanuel Macron. This action is part of a broader effort by the US administration to isolate France and potentially influence international bodies. The White House's strategy appears to involve pressuring companies to disassociate from French initiatives, as seen in previous instances where the administration sought to limit the Smithsonian Institution's engagement with international partners. The specific companies targeted and the full extent of the US administration's diplomatic pressure remain unclear from the provided coverage.
